title: End of year examinations
details: Final assessments for Term III. Learners should arrive by 7:30 AM with all their stationery.

title: Bunono Graduation and Speech Day
details: Top Class graduates in caps and gowns, performances from every class and the Head Teacher's address. Parents and guardians are warmly invited.

title: Nalugala Graduation and Speech Day
details: Top Class graduation, prize giving and performances. Parents and guardians are warmly invited.

title: Term III ends
details: Report cards are issued at the close of the day. Boarders are collected from 12:00 noon.

title: Christmas holiday
details: The office stays open on weekdays for admissions, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, except over Christmas and New Year.

title: Boarders report for Term I
details: Boarders arrive with their requirements, checked in by the matron and the class teacher.

title: Term I 2027 begins
details: All learners report in full uniform. Fees are payable through the School Pay System by the first day of term.

title: Janani Luwum Day
details: Public holiday. No classes.

title: Parents' meeting (PTA)
details: Meet the class teachers, hear the plan for the year and elect class representatives.

title: Nalugala Visitation Day
details: Parents and guardians of boarders are welcome. Please carry your child's visitation card.

title: International Women's Day
details: Public holiday. No classes.

title: Bunono Visitation Day
details: Parents and guardians of boarders are welcome. Please carry your child's visitation card.

title: Easter mid term break
details: Learners go home on Thursday at 1:00 PM and return on Tuesday 30 March by 7:30 AM.

title: Term I ends
details: Report cards are issued at the close of the day.

title: Term II 2027 begins
details: Boarders may arrive from 2:00 PM on Sunday 23 May.

title: Uganda Martyrs Day
details: Public holiday. No classes.

title: Heroes Day
details: Public holiday. No classes.

title: Inter house Sports Day
details: Athletics, swimming and games between the houses at both campuses. Parents are welcome to come and cheer.

title: Term II ends
details: Report cards are issued at the close of the day.

title: Term III 2027 begins
details: Boarders may arrive from 2:00 PM on Sunday 12 September.
